qEn: A developer needs to set up an SSL security certificate for a client's eCommerce website in order to use the HTTPS protocol. Which of the following AWS services can be used to deploy the required SSL server certificates? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 開發人員需要為客戶的電子商務網站設定 SSL 安全憑證，以便使用 HTTPS 協定。下列哪些 AWS 服務可用於部署所需的 SSL 伺服器憑證？（選擇兩個）
expEn: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) is the primary service to provision, manage, and deploy SSL/TLS certificates. If you have certificates from a third party that aren't supported by ACM, you can upload and manage them using AWS IAM.
expZh: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 是佈建、管理和部署 SSL/TLS 憑證的主要服務。如果您擁有不被 ACM 支援的第三方憑證，您可以使用 AWS IAM 上傳和管理它們。

qEn: Which of the following AWS services scale automatically without your intervention? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些 AWS 服務無需您的介入即可自動擴展？（選擇兩個）
expEn: Amazon S3 automatically scales storage capacity and throughput, while AWS Lambda automatically scales compute capacity to match the incoming request rate. EC2 requires Auto Scaling groups to be configured.
expZh: Amazon S3 會自動擴展儲存容量和吞吐量，而 AWS Lambda 會自動擴展運算容量以符合傳入的請求率。EC2 需要設定 Auto Scaling 群組才能自動擴展。

qEn: A company is planning to migrate an application from Amazon EC2 to AWS Lambda to use a serverless architecture. Which of the following will be the responsibility of AWS after migration? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 一家公司計畫將應用程式從 Amazon EC2 遷移至 AWS Lambda，以使用無伺服器 (serverless) 架構。遷移後，下列哪些將成為 AWS 的責任？（選擇兩個）
expEn: With AWS Lambda (a serverless service), AWS is completely responsible for maintaining the underlying infrastructure, including capacity management (auto-scaling) and operating system maintenance (patching).
expZh: 使用 AWS Lambda（無伺服器服務）時，AWS 完全負責維護底層基礎架構，包括容量管理（自動擴展）和作業系統維護（修補）。

qEn: How do ELBs improve the reliability of your application?
qZh: ELB (彈性負載平衡器) 如何提高您應用程式的可靠性？
optionsEn: By distributing traffic across multiple S3 buckets.
By replicating data to multiple availability zones.
By ensuring that only healthy targets receive traffic.
optionsZh: 透過在多個 S3 儲存貯體之間分配流量。
透過將資料複製到多個可用區域。
透過建立資料庫唯讀複本 (Read Replicas)。
透過確保只有健康的目標才會接收流量。
expEn: Elastic Load Balancers (ELBs) continually monitor the health of their registered targets and automatically route traffic away from unhealthy targets to healthy ones, thereby improving application reliability.
expZh: 彈性負載平衡器 (ELB) 會持續監控其註冊目標的健康狀態，並自動將流量從不健康的目標路由到健康的目標，從而提高應用程式的可靠性。

qEn: A company needs to migrate their website from on-premises to AWS. Security is a major concern for them, so they need to host their website on hardware that is NOT shared with other AWS customers. Which of the following EC2 instance options meets this requirement?
qZh: 一家公司需要將其網站從本地端遷移到 AWS。安全性是他們的主要考量，因此他們需要將網站託管在「未與其他 AWS 客戶共用」的硬體上。下列哪種 EC2 執行個體選項符合此需求？
expEn: Dedicated Instances are Amazon EC2 instances that run in a virtual private cloud (VPC) on hardware that's dedicated to a single customer, ensuring physical isolation from other AWS accounts.
expZh: 專用執行個體是在虛擬私有雲 (VPC) 中執行的 Amazon EC2 執行個體，其硬體專屬於單一客戶，確保與其他 AWS 帳戶實體隔離。

qEn: A customer is planning to move billions of images and videos to be stored on Amazon S3. The customer has approximately 60 Petabytes of data to move. Which of the following AWS Services is the best choice to transfer the data to AWS?
qZh: 客戶計畫移動數十億張圖片和影片以儲存在 Amazon S3 上。客戶大約有 60 PB (Petabytes) 的資料需要移動。下列哪項 AWS 服務是將資料傳輸至 AWS 的最佳選擇？
expEn: AWS Snowmobile is an Exabyte-scale data transfer service used to move extremely large amounts of data to AWS (up to 100PB per Snowmobile). For 60PB, Snowmobile is the most efficient choice.
expZh: AWS Snowmobile 是一種 Exabyte 等級的資料傳輸服務，用於將極大量的資料移至 AWS（每輛 Snowmobile 高達 100PB）。對於 60PB 的資料，Snowmobile 是最有效率的選擇。

qEn: A company plans to migrate a large amount of archived data to AWS. The archived data must be maintained for a period of 5 years and must be retrievable within 5 hours of a request. What is the most cost-effective AWS storage service to use?
qZh: 一家公司計畫將大量的封存資料遷移至 AWS。封存資料必須保存 5 年，並且必須在提出請求後的 5 小時內可供檢索。使用哪項 AWS 儲存服務最具成本效益？
expEn: Amazon S3 Glacier is highly cost-effective for long-term data archiving where retrieval times of minutes to hours are acceptable.
expZh: 對於可接受數分鐘到數小時檢索時間的長期資料封存，Amazon S3 Glacier 具有極高的成本效益。

qEn: Which AWS Service is used to manage user permissions?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務用於管理使用者權限？
expEn: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) enables you to securely control access to AWS services and resources for your users.
expZh: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 使您能夠安全地控制使用者對 AWS 服務和資源的存取。

qEn: Which support plan includes AWS Support Concierge Service?
qZh: 哪個支援計畫包含 AWS Support Concierge 服務？
expEn: The AWS Support Concierge service is a feature exclusive to the Enterprise Support plan, providing billing and account assistance.
expZh: AWS Support Concierge 服務是企業級支援計畫專有的功能，提供帳單和帳戶方面的協助。

qEn: A company needs to track resource changes using the API call history. Which AWS service can help the company achieve this goal?
qZh: 一家公司需要使用 API 呼叫歷史記錄來追蹤資源變更。哪項 AWS 服務可協助該公司達成此目標？
expEn: AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls for your account and delivers log files to you, allowing you to track resource changes, compliance, and governance.
expZh: AWS CloudTrail 記錄您帳戶的 AWS API 呼叫並將日誌檔傳送給您，讓您能追蹤資源變更、合規性和治理。

qEn: What are the benefits of using an AWS-managed service? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 使用 AWS 受管服務 (managed service) 的好處是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Provides complete control over the virtual infrastructure.
Allows customers to deliver new solutions faster.
Eliminates the need to encrypt data.
Allows developers to control all patching related activities.
optionsZh: 提供對虛擬基礎架構的完全控制。
允許客戶更快地交付新的解決方案。
消除了加密資料的需求。
允許開發人員控制所有與修補相關的活動。
expEn: Managed services (like RDS or DynamoDB) reduce operational complexity by offloading maintenance tasks (patching, backups) to AWS, freeing developers to build and deliver solutions faster.
expZh: 受管服務（如 RDS 或 DynamoDB）透過將維護任務（修補、備份）卸載給 AWS 來降低維運複雜度，讓開發人員騰出時間更快地建立和交付解決方案。

qEn: Which of the following are use cases for Amazon S3? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些是 Amazon S3 的使用案例？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Hosting websites that require sustained high CPU utilization.
A media store for the CloudFront service.
Processing data streams at any scale.
optionsZh: 託管需要持續高 CPU 使用率的網站。
具成本效益的資料庫和日誌儲存。
作為 CloudFront 服務的媒體儲存庫。
處理任何規模的資料流。
expEn: Amazon S3 is ideal for hosting static websites (HTML, CSS, images) and acts as the perfect, highly available origin store for distributing media assets via Amazon CloudFront.
expZh: Amazon S3 非常適合託管靜態網站（HTML、CSS、圖片），並作為透過 Amazon CloudFront 分發媒體資產的完美、高可用性原始儲存庫。

qEn: What is the AWS’ recommendation regarding access keys?
qZh: 關於存取金鑰 (access keys)，AWS 的建議是什麼？
optionsEn: Delete all access keys and use passwords instead.
Only share them with trusted people.
Save them within your application code.
optionsZh: 刪除所有存取金鑰，改用密碼。
將它們儲存在您的應用程式碼中。
expEn: AWS security best practices recommend changing (rotating) access keys on a regular schedule to shorten the period an access key is active and reduce the business impact if it is compromised.
expZh: AWS 安全最佳實踐建議定期更改（輪換）存取金鑰，以縮短存取金鑰處於活動狀態的期間，並減少萬一其遭到洩露時的業務影響。

qEn: What is the AWS IAM feature that provides an additional layer of security on top of user-name and password authentication?
qZh: 哪項 AWS IAM 功能在使用者名稱和密碼身分驗證之上，提供了額外的安全層級？
expEn: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds extra security by requiring users to enter a unique authentication code from a trusted device in addition to their regular credentials.
expZh: 多重要素身分驗證 (MFA) 透過要求使用者除了常規憑證外，還必須輸入來自受信任裝置的獨特驗證碼，從而增加了額外的安全性。

qEn: What is the benefit of using an API to access AWS Services?
qZh: 使用 API 存取 AWS 服務有什麼好處？
optionsEn: It improves the performance of AWS resources.
It reduces the time needed to provision AWS resources.
It reduces the number of developers necessary.
It allows for programmatic management of AWS resources.
optionsZh: 它可以提高 AWS 資源的效能。
它可以減少佈建 AWS 資源所需的時間。
它可以減少所需的開發人員數量。
它允許以程式化 (programmatic) 方式管理 AWS 資源。
expEn: APIs allow developers to integrate AWS services directly into their applications and scripts, enabling programmatic, automated management of cloud infrastructure.
expZh: API 允許開發人員將 AWS 服務直接整合到其應用程式和指令碼中，實現雲端基礎架構的程式化、自動化管理。

qEn: A company is planning to migrate a database with high read/write activity to AWS. What is the best storage option to use?
qZh: 一家公司計畫將具有高讀/寫活動的資料庫遷移到 AWS。使用的最佳儲存選項是什麼？
expEn: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) provides highly available, consistent, low-latency block storage that is optimized for use with EC2, making it the perfect choice for database storage.
expZh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) 提供高可用性、一致、低延遲的區塊儲存，專為與 EC2 搭配使用而優化，使其成為資料庫儲存的完美選擇。

qEn: How can AWS customers track and avoid over-spending on underutilized reserved instances?
qZh: AWS 客戶如何追蹤並避免在未充分利用的預留執行個體上超支？
optionsEn: Customers can add all AWS accounts to an AWS Organization, enable Consolidated Billing, and turn off Reserved Instance sharing.
Customers can use Amazon Neptune to track and analyze their usage patterns, detect underutilized reserved instances, and then sell them on the Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace.
Customers can use the AWS Budgets service to track the reserved instances usage and set up alert notifications when their utilization drops below the threshold that they define.
Customers can use Amazon CloudTrail to automatically check for unused reservations and get recommendations to reduce their bill.
optionsZh: 客戶可以將所有 AWS 帳戶新增至 AWS Organization，啟用合併帳單，然後關閉預留執行個體共享。
客戶可以使用 Amazon Neptune 追蹤和分析他們的使用模式，檢測未充分利用的預留執行個體，然後在 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace 上出售它們。
客戶可以使用 AWS Budgets 服務追蹤預留執行個體的使用情況，並在利用率低於他們定義的閾值時設定警示通知。
客戶可以使用 Amazon CloudTrail 自動檢查未使用的預留並獲得降低帳單的建議。
expEn: AWS Budgets allows you to set custom Reservation Utilization budgets, which let you track the utilization rate of your Reserved Instances and alert you when it drops below your target.
expZh: AWS Budgets 允許您設定自訂的「預留利用率預算」，讓您能追蹤預留執行個體的利用率，並在低於您的目標時發出警示。

qEn: What is the AWS service that provides five times the performance of a standard MySQL database?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務提供五倍於標準 MySQL 資料庫的效能？
expEn: Amazon Aurora is a fully managed relational database engine that's compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL, offering up to five times the throughput of standard MySQL.
expZh: Amazon Aurora 是一個全託管的關聯式資料庫引擎，相容於 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL，提供的吞吐量高達標準 MySQL 的五倍。

qEn: What does AWS Service Catalog provide?
qZh: AWS Service Catalog 提供什麼功能？
optionsEn: It enables customers to quickly find descriptions and use cases for AWS services.
It enables customers to explore the different catalogs of AWS services.
It simplifies organizing and governing commonly deployed IT services.
It allows developers to deploy infrastructure on AWS using familiar programming languages.
optionsZh: 它使客戶能夠快速找到 AWS 服務的描述和使用案例。
它使客戶能夠探索不同目錄的 AWS 服務。
它簡化了組織和治理常用部署的 IT 服務。
它允許開發人員使用熟悉的程式語言在 AWS 上部署基礎架構。
expEn: AWS Service Catalog allows organizations to create and manage catalogs of IT services that are approved for use on AWS, ensuring consistent governance and compliance.
expZh: AWS Service Catalog 允許組織建立和管理經核准可在 AWS 上使用的 IT 服務目錄，確保一致的治理和合規性。

qEn: For managed services like Amazon DynamoDB, which of the below is AWS responsible for? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 對於像 Amazon DynamoDB 這樣的受管服務 (managed services)，下列哪些是 AWS 的責任？（選擇兩個）
expEn: With fully managed services, AWS takes on the heavy lifting of infrastructure maintenance, including OS patching, database software updates, and hardware management.
expZh: 對於全託管服務，AWS 承擔了基礎架構維護的繁重工作，包括作業系統修補、資料庫軟體更新和硬體管理。

qEn: Which of the following AWS Services helps with planning application migration to the AWS Cloud?
qZh: 下列哪項 AWS 服務有助於規劃將應用程式遷移到 AWS 雲端？
expEn: AWS Application Discovery Service helps enterprise customers plan migration projects by gathering information about their on-premises data centers, understanding application dependencies, and estimating TCO.
expZh: AWS Application Discovery Service 透過收集有關客戶本地資料中心的資訊、了解應用程式依賴性並估算 TCO，來協助企業客戶規劃遷移專案。

qEn: A company is trying to analyze the costs applied to their AWS account recently. Which of the following provides them the most granular data about their AWS costs and usage?
qZh: 一家公司正試圖分析最近套用到其 AWS 帳戶的成本。下列哪一項為他們提供了關於其 AWS 成本和用量最精細 (granular) 的資料？
optionsZh: AWS 成本與用量報告 (Cost & Usage Report)。
expEn: The AWS Cost & Usage Report (CUR) contains the most comprehensive set of cost and usage data available, breaking down costs down to the hour or day, by product, resource, or tags.
expZh: AWS 成本與用量報告 (CUR) 包含最全面的成本和用量資料，可按產品、資源或標籤將成本細分到小時或天。

qEn: Which statement best describes the concept of an AWS region?
qZh: 哪項敘述最能描述 AWS 區域 (Region) 的概念？
optionsEn: An AWS Region is a geographical location with a collection of Edge locations.
An AWS Region is a virtual network dedicated only to a single AWS customer.
An AWS Region is a geographical location with a collection of Availability Zones.
An AWS Region represents the country where the AWS infrastructure exist.
optionsZh: AWS 區域是具有邊緣站點集合的地理位置。
AWS 區域是專為單一 AWS 客戶準備的虛擬網路。
AWS 區域是具有多個可用區域 (Availability Zones) 集合的地理位置。
AWS 區域代表 AWS 基礎架構所在的國家。
expEn: An AWS Region is a physical, geographical location in the world where AWS clusters data centers. Each group of logical data centers is called an Availability Zone (AZ).
expZh: AWS 區域是世界上 AWS 叢集資料中心的實體地理位置。每組邏輯資料中心被稱為一個可用區域 (AZ)。

qEn: A company has discovered that multiple S3 buckets were deleted, but it is unclear who deleted the buckets. Which of the following can the company use to determine the identity that deleted the buckets?
qZh: 一家公司發現多個 S3 儲存貯體被刪除，但不清楚是誰刪除了這些貯體。該公司可以使用下列哪一項來確定刪除貯體的身分？
expEn: AWS CloudTrail records the API calls made in your account (including 'DeleteBucket'), allowing you to identify which user, role, or AWS service took the action.
expZh: AWS CloudTrail 記錄在您帳戶中進行的 API 呼叫（包括「刪除貯體」），讓您能夠識別是哪個使用者、角色或 AWS 服務執行了該動作。

qEn: Which of the following are factors in determining the appropriate database technology to use for a specific workload? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 決定特定工作負載使用適當資料庫技術時，下列哪些是考量因素？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: The number of reads and writes per second.
optionsZh: 每秒的讀取和寫入次數 (IOPS)。
查詢的性質 (Nature of the queries)。
expEn: Database selection is driven by workload requirements such as throughput performance (reads/writes per second) and how the data will be queried (relational SQL vs. flexible NoSQL).
expZh: 資料庫的選擇取決於工作負載需求，例如吞吐量效能（每秒讀/寫次數）以及資料將如何被查詢（關聯式 SQL 對比 靈活的 NoSQL）。

qEn: What are the benefits of implementing a tagging strategy for AWS resources? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 為 AWS 資源實施標籤 (tagging) 策略有什麼好處？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Quickly identify resources that belong to a specific project.
Quickly identify software solutions on AWS.
Track API calls in your AWS account.
Quickly identify deleted resources and their metadata.
Track AWS spending across multiple resources.
optionsZh: 快速識別屬於特定專案的資源。
快速識別 AWS 上的軟體解決方案。
追蹤您 AWS 帳戶中的 API 呼叫。
快速識別已刪除的資源及其元資料。
追蹤多個資源的 AWS 支出。
expEn: Tags are metadata (key-value pairs) you assign to resources. They help you organize and identify resources (e.g., by project, environment) and are crucial for cost allocation and billing tracking.
expZh: 標籤是您指派給資源的元資料（鍵值對）。它們可協助您組織和識別資源（例如，依專案、環境），且對於成本分配和帳單追蹤至關重要。

qEn: What are AWS shared controls?
qZh: 什麼是 AWS 共同控制項 (shared controls)？
optionsEn: Controls that are solely the responsibility of the customer based on the application they are deploying within AWS services.
Controls that a customer inherits from AWS.
Controls that apply to both the infrastructure layer and customer layers.
Controls that the customer and AWS collaborate together upon to secure the infrastructure.
optionsZh: 完全由客戶負責的控制項，基於他們在 AWS 服務內部署的應用程式。
客戶從 AWS 繼承的控制項。
同時適用於基礎架構層和客戶層的控制項。
客戶和 AWS 共同合作以確保基礎架構安全的控制項。
expEn: In the Shared Responsibility Model, shared controls apply to both AWS (infrastructure) and the customer (guest OS, application). Examples include Patch Management and Configuration Management.
expZh: 在責任共擔模型中，共同控制項同時適用於 AWS（基礎架構）和客戶（客體作業系統、應用程式）。範例包括修補管理和組態管理。

qEn: Which design principles relate to performance efficiency in AWS? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 哪些設計原則與 AWS 中的「效能效率 (performance efficiency)」有關？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Build multi-region architectures to better serve global customers.
Implement strong Identity and Access controls.
optionsZh: 建立多區域架構以更好地服務全球客戶。
實施強大的身分和存取控制。
使用無伺服器 (serverless) 架構。
expEn: Performance Efficiency principles include 'Go global in minutes' (multi-region architectures for lower latency) and 'Use serverless architectures' (removing the operational burden of managing servers).
expZh: 效能效率原則包括「在幾分鐘內走向全球」（用於降低延遲的多區域架構）和「使用無伺服器架構」（消除管理伺服器的維運負擔）。

qEn: Which of the below are responsibilities of the customer when using Amazon EC2? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 使用 Amazon EC2 時，下列哪些是客戶的責任？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Setup and operation of managed databases.
optionsZh: 受管資料庫的設定和操作。
安裝和設定第三方軟體。
expEn: For an IaaS service like EC2, the customer is responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud', which includes managing the data, guest OS, and any installed third-party software.
expZh: 對於像 EC2 這樣的 IaaS 服務，客戶負責「雲端內部的安全」，其中包括管理資料、客體作業系統和任何安裝的第三方軟體。

qEn: Why would an organization decide to use AWS over an on-premises data center? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 為什麼一個組織會決定使用 AWS 而不是本地資料中心？（選擇兩個）
expEn: AWS offers elasticity (the ability to scale resources up and down instantly to match demand) and cost savings (pay-as-you-go pricing, avoiding upfront CapEx for data centers).
expZh: AWS 提供彈性（能夠立即向上和向下擴展資源以匹配需求）和節省成本（隨收隨付定價，避免資料中心的預付資本支出）。

qEn: Which of the following AWS services can help you perform security analysis and regulatory compliance auditing? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些 AWS 服務可以協助您執行安全分析和法規遵循稽核？（選擇兩個）
expEn: Amazon Inspector automatically assesses applications for vulnerabilities or deviations from best practices. AWS Config enables you to assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations of your AWS resources for compliance.
expZh: Amazon Inspector 會自動評估應用程式的漏洞或偏離最佳實踐的情況。AWS Config 可讓您評估、稽核和評測 AWS 資源的組態設定以確保合規性。

qEn: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2)?
qZh: 下列哪一項「不是」Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) 的特性？
optionsEn: Amazon EC2 is considered a Serverless Web Service.
Amazon EC2 eliminates the need to invest in hardware upfront.
Amazon EC2 can launch as many or as few virtual servers as needed.
optionsZh: Amazon EC2 被認為是一種無伺服器 (Serverless) 的 Web 服務。
Amazon EC2 消除了預先投資硬體的需求。
Amazon EC2 可以根據需要啟動任意數量的虛擬伺服器。
Amazon EC2 提供可擴展的運算。
expEn: Amazon EC2 is an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), meaning you provision and manage virtual servers. Services like AWS Lambda are considered Serverless.
expZh: Amazon EC2 是一種基礎設施即服務 (IaaS)，意味著您需要配置和管理虛擬伺服器。像 AWS Lambda 這樣的服務才被認為是無伺服器的。

qEn: What is the AWS Compute service that executes code only when triggered by events?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 運算服務僅在由事件觸發時才執行程式碼？
expEn: AWS Lambda is an event-driven, serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events (like an object uploaded to S3 or an HTTP request via API Gateway).
expZh: AWS Lambda 是一種事件驅動的無伺服器運算服務，它根據事件（例如上傳到 S3 的物件或透過 API Gateway 的 HTTP 請求）來執行您的程式碼。

qEn: Both AWS and traditional IT distributors provide a wide range of virtual servers to meet their customers’ requirements. What is the name of these virtual servers in AWS?
qZh: AWS 和傳統 IT 經銷商都提供廣泛的虛擬伺服器以滿足客戶的需求。這些虛擬伺服器在 AWS 中的名稱是什麼？
expEn: In AWS terminology, a virtual server is referred to as an Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) instance.
expZh: 在 AWS 術語中，虛擬伺服器被稱為 Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) 執行個體。

qEn: What is the framework created by AWS Professional Services that helps organizations design a road map to successful cloud adoption?
qZh: 由 AWS 專業服務 (Professional Services) 建立，旨在協助組織設計成功雲端採用路線圖的框架是什麼？
expEn: The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) provides guidance and best practices to help organizations plan and manage their transition to the cloud.
expZh: AWS 雲端採用框架 (AWS CAF) 提供指引和最佳實踐，協助組織規劃和管理其向雲端的轉型。

qEn: TYMO Cloud Corp is looking forward to migrating their entire on-premises data center to AWS. What tool can they use to perform a cost-benefit analysis of moving to the AWS Cloud?
qZh: TYMO Cloud Corp 期待將其整個本地資料中心遷移至 AWS。他們可以使用什麼工具來執行遷移至 AWS 雲端的成本效益分析？
expEn: The AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator (often supported by AWS Migration Evaluator today) allows you to compare the cost of running your applications in an on-premises or colocation environment to AWS.
expZh: AWS 總體擁有成本 (TCO) 計算機（如今通常由 AWS Migration Evaluator 支援）讓您能夠比較在本地或主機代管環境與 AWS 中執行應用程式的成本。

qEn: Which of the following activities supports the Operational Excellence pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
qZh: 下列哪項活動支援 AWS 良好架構框架中的「卓越營運」支柱？
optionsEn: Using AWS Trusted Advisor to find underutilized resources.
Using AWS CloudTrail to record user activities.
Using AWS CloudFormation to manage infrastructure as code.
Deploying an application in multiple Availability Zones.
optionsZh: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 尋找未充分利用的資源。
使用 AWS CloudTrail 記錄使用者活動。
使用 AWS CloudFormation 以程式碼形式管理基礎架構 (Infrastructure as Code)。
在多個可用區域中部署應用程式。
expEn: Performing operations as code (using tools like AWS CloudFormation) is a core design principle for the Operational Excellence pillar, enabling consistent deployment and reliable changes.
expZh: 以程式碼形式執行維運（使用 AWS CloudFormation 等工具）是卓越營運支柱的核心設計原則，可實現一致的部署和可靠的變更。

qEn: Why do many startup companies prefer AWS over traditional on-premises solutions? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 為什麼許多新創公司偏好 AWS 而非傳統的本地解決方案？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: AWS allows them to pay later when their business succeed.
AWS can build complete data centers faster than any other Cloud provider.
Using AWS, they can reduce time-to-market by focusing on business activities rather than on building and managing data centers.
AWS removes the need to invest in operational expenditure.
Using AWS allows companies to replace large capital expenditure with low variable costs.
optionsZh: AWS 允許他們在業務成功後再付款。
AWS 建立完整資料中心的速度比任何其他雲端供應商都快。
使用 AWS，他們可以專注於業務活動，而不是建置和管理資料中心，從而縮短上市時間。
AWS 消除了對營運支出 (OpEx) 的投資需求。
使用 AWS 允許公司以較低的變動成本 (variable costs) 取代大量的資本支出 (CapEx)。
expEn: Startups benefit from agility (reducing time-to-market by skipping hardware setup) and shifting CapEx (upfront data center costs) to OpEx (pay-as-you-go variable costs).
expZh: 新創公司受惠於敏捷性（跳過硬體設定以縮短上市時間）以及將 CapEx（預付資料中心成本）轉為 OpEx（隨收隨付的變動成本）。

qEn: What are the benefits of using DynamoDB? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 使用 DynamoDB 的好處是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Automatically scales to meet required throughput capacity.
Provides resizable instances to match the current demand.
Supports both relational and non-relational data models.
Supports the most popular NoSQL database engines such as CouchDB and MongoDB.
optionsZh: 自動擴展以滿足所需的吞吐容量。
提供可調整大小的執行個體以符合目前需求。
支援關聯式和非關聯式資料模型。
提供極低（個位數毫秒）的延遲。
支援最受歡迎的 NoSQL 資料庫引擎，例如 CouchDB 和 MongoDB。
expEn: Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service that provides fast and predictable performance (single-digit millisecond latency) and seamlessly scales throughput capacity automatically.
expZh: Amazon DynamoDB 是一種全託管的 NoSQL 資料庫服務，提供快速且可預測的效能（個位數毫秒延遲），並能無縫且自動地擴展吞吐容量。

qEn: Which of the following can be used to protect data at rest on Amazon S3? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些可用於保護 Amazon S3 中的靜態資料 (data at rest)？（選擇兩個）
expEn: To protect data at rest in S3 from accidental deletion or unauthorized access, you can use S3 Versioning (to recover deleted/overwritten objects) and proper access Permissions (IAM policies, bucket policies). Encryption (not decryption) is also used.
expZh: 為保護 S3 中的靜態資料免於意外刪除或未經授權的存取，您可以使用 S3 版本控制（還原已刪除/覆寫的物件）和適當的存取權限（IAM 政策、貯體政策）。也會使用加密（而非解密）。

qEn: As part of the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), what does AWS provide to accelerate Enterprise adoption of AWS? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 作為 AWS 遷移加速計畫 (MAP) 的一部分，AWS 提供什麼來加速企業採用 AWS？（選擇兩個）
expEn: AWS MAP is supported by a robust ecosystem of AWS Migration Partners and AWS Professional Services teams who provide the expertise and tools to execute large-scale migrations.
expZh: AWS MAP 獲得 AWS 遷移合作夥伴和 AWS 專業服務團隊所組成之強大生態系統的支援，他們提供執行大規模遷移的專業知識和工具。

qEn: AWS recommends some practices to help organizations avoid unexpected charges on their bill. Which of the following is NOT one of these practices?
qZh: AWS 建議了一些實踐，以幫助組織避免帳單上出現意外費用。下列哪項「不」是這些實踐之一？
optionsEn: Deleting unused EBS volumes after terminating an EC2 instance.
Releasing unused Elastic IPs after terminating an EC2 instance.
optionsZh: 在終止 EC2 執行個體後，刪除未使用的 EBS 磁碟區。
刪除未使用的 AutoScaling 啟動組態 (launch configuration)。
刪除未使用的彈性負載平衡器 (ELB)。
在終止 EC2 執行個體後，釋放未使用的彈性 IP。
expEn: Unused Auto Scaling launch configurations do not incur charges, so deleting them does not save money. However, retaining unattached EBS volumes, unused ELBs, and unattached Elastic IPs will continue to generate costs.
expZh: 未使用的 Auto Scaling 啟動組態不會產生費用，因此刪除它們並不能省錢。然而，保留未連接的 EBS 磁碟區、未使用的 ELB 以及未連接的彈性 IP 將會持續產生費用。

qEn: What is the AWS tool that can help a company visualize their AWS spending in the last few months?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 工具可協助公司視覺化他們過去幾個月的 AWS 支出？
expEn: AWS Cost Explorer provides a visual interface that lets you view, understand, and analyze your AWS costs and usage over time, including historical data for the last several months.
expZh: AWS Cost Explorer 提供了一個視覺化介面，讓您可以查看、理解和分析隨時間推移的 AWS 成本和用量，包括過去幾個月的歷史資料。

qEn: When running a workload in AWS, the customer is NOT responsible for: (Select TWO)
qZh: 在 AWS 中執行工作負載時，客戶「不」負責：（選擇兩個）
expEn: According to the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS handles 'Security OF the Cloud,' which includes physical data center operations and the security of the foundational infrastructure (compute, storage, database, networking facilities).
expZh: 根據責任共擔模型，AWS 負責「雲端本身的安全」，其中包括實體資料中心的維運以及基礎架構（運算、儲存、資料庫、網路設施）的安全。

qEn: Which AWS service can be used to send promotional text messages (SMS) to more than 200 countries worldwide?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務可用於向全球 200 多個國家/地區發送促銷文字簡訊 (SMS)？
expEn: Amazon SNS allows you to send SMS text messages directly to mobile phone numbers in over 200 countries, making it ideal for promotional messages, alerts, and MFA codes.
expZh: Amazon SNS 允許您直接將 SMS 文字簡訊發送到 200 多個國家的手機號碼，非常適合發送促銷訊息、警報和 MFA 驗證碼。

qEn: Which of the following allows you to create new RDS instances? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些允許您建立新的 RDS 執行個體？（選擇兩個）
expEn: You can provision RDS instances manually via the AWS Management Console, or you can automate their creation using infrastructure-as-code tools like AWS CloudFormation.
expZh: 您可以透過 AWS 管理控制台手動配置 RDS 執行個體，也可以使用 AWS CloudFormation 等基礎架構即程式碼工具自動建立它們。

qEn: One of the major advantages of using AWS is cost savings. What does AWS provide to reduce the cost of running Amazon EC2 instances?
qZh: 使用 AWS 的主要優勢之一是節省成本。AWS 提供什麼來降低執行 Amazon EC2 執行個體的成本？
optionsZh: 低廉的每月執行個體維護成本。
低成本的執行個體標記。
低廉的執行個體啟動費用。
expEn: AWS offers per-second billing for certain EC2 instances (like Linux and Ubuntu), which allows you to pay only for the exact compute time you use, avoiding charges for unused minutes.
expZh: AWS 為特定的 EC2 執行個體（如 Linux 和 Ubuntu）提供按秒計費，這讓您只需為實際使用的運算時間付費，避免為未使用的分鐘數付費。

qEn: Which AWS Group assists customers in achieving their desired business outcomes?
qZh: 哪個 AWS 團隊協助客戶達成他們期望的業務成果？
expEn: AWS Professional Services is a global team of experts that can help you realize your desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud by providing guidance, architecture, and deployment assistance.
expZh: AWS 專業服務是一個全球專家團隊，可以透過提供指引、架構和部署協助，幫您在使用 AWS 雲端時實現期望的業務成果。

qEn: Which AWS service or feature is used to manage the keys used to encrypt customer data?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務或功能用於管理加密客戶資料的金鑰？
expEn: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) makes it easy for you to create and manage cryptographic keys and control their use across a wide range of AWS services and in your applications.
expZh: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) 讓您能輕鬆建立和管理密碼編譯金鑰，並控制它們在各種 AWS 服務和您的應用程式中的使用。

qEn: Which AWS Service allows customers to download AWS SOC & PCI reports?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務允許客戶下載 AWS SOC 和 PCI 報告？
expEn: AWS Artifact is your go-to, central resource for compliance-related information that matters to you. It provides on-demand access to AWS’ security and compliance reports (like SOC, PCI) and select online agreements.
expZh: AWS Artifact 是您獲取重要合規相關資訊的首選集中資源。它提供對 AWS 安全與合規報告（如 SOC、PCI）和特定線上協議的隨需存取。
